dialogues.jp: どうしてばあちゃんが死んだのか。
dialogues.en: Why did grandma die?
dialogues.text: Why did grandma die?

dialogues.jp: それが不思議だった。
dialogues.en: I still wonder to this day.
dialogues.text: I still wonder to this day.

dialogues.jp:
魔法使いならもっと長く生きられるはずだし、
もっと若い姿でもよかったし、｛ほうき／箒｝にのって空を
飛んだりも出来るはずなのに……。
dialogues.en:
A witch can live much longer, and she could have looked much
younger, or she could have even taken flight on a broom.
dialogues.text:
A witch can live much longer, and she could have looked much
younger, or she could have even taken flight on a broom.

dialogues.jp:
ばあちゃんに見せてもらった魔法は、なにもな
いところから和菓子をだすことだけだった。
dialogues.en:
The only magic she ever showed me was how to create Japanese
sweets from your hand.
dialogues.text:
The only magic she ever showed me was how to create Japanese
sweets from your hand.

dialogues.jp:
少しだけ成長した俺は、ある日の言葉を思い出
す。
dialogues.en: I remember what she told me once upon a time.
dialogues.text: I remember what she told me once upon a time.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「そうね、わたしも長く生きているわ」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I've lived a long life."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I've lived a long life."

dialogues.jp:
その言葉が、人間の尺におさまっているかまで、
子供の俺には気がまわらなかった。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't tell if she was talking about it as a human
lifetime or not at the time.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't tell if she was talking about it as a human
lifetime or not at the time.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「確かに美人、ってモノからは縁遠くなっちゃっ
　たけど……」
dialogues.en: "I'm definitely not beautiful anymore......"
dialogues.text: "I'm definitely not beautiful anymore......"

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「でも、後悔するどころか、本当に嬉しいこと
　ばかりだったわ」
dialogues.en:
"But I have no regrets about it, and I even enjoyed it very
much."
dialogues.text:
"But I have no regrets about it, and I even enjoyed it very
much."

dialogues.jp: あなたに会えたこともね、とばあちゃんは笑う。
dialogues.en: Including meeting you, she smiled.
dialogues.text: Including meeting you, she smiled.

dialogues.jp: 魔法が使えなくなっちゃったから年をとったの？
dialogues.en: Did you get old because you can't use your magic anymore?
dialogues.text: Did you get old because you can't use your magic anymore?

dialogues.jp: 俺の言葉に、ばあちゃんは『ええ』と笑う。
dialogues.en: She smiled and said "Yes.".
dialogues.text: She smiled and said "Yes.".

dialogues.jp: どうして魔法が使えなくなったの？
dialogues.en: Why did you lose your magic?
dialogues.text: Why did you lose your magic?

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「それは、あなたに会うためよ」
dialogues.en: "So I can meet you."
dialogues.text: "So I can meet you."

dialogues.jp: その答えも難しくて分からなかった。
dialogues.en: I couldn't understand what she meant by that.
dialogues.text: I couldn't understand what she meant by that.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「……実はそれも恋をしたからなんだけど。魔
　法使いは、人を本当に好きになると魔法が使
　えなくなるの」
dialogues.en:
"Well, it's because I fell in love. Witches can't use their
magic when they fall in love."
dialogues.text:
"Well, it's because I fell in love. Witches can't use their
magic when they fall in love."

dialogues.jp: やっぱり分からない。
dialogues.en: I still don't understand.
dialogues.text: I still don't understand.

dialogues.jp: 俺は｛ようかん／羊羹｝を食べながら首をかしげた。
dialogues.en: I tilted my head as I ate a Japanese sweet.
dialogues.text: I tilted my head as I ate a Japanese sweet.

dialogues.jp: ばあちゃんは可笑しそうに目を閉じる。
dialogues.en: She closed her eyes smiling.
dialogues.text: She closed her eyes smiling.

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp: 「そうね、あなたにもいつか分かるわ……」
dialogues.en: "I'm sure you'll understand it someday......"
dialogues.text: "I'm sure you'll understand it someday......"

dialogues.speaker: Grandma
dialogues.jp:
「恋をするってことは、それだけ大変で――か
　けがえのない魔法なんだから」
dialogues.en:
"Being in love has its challenges, but to fall in love is
like magic itself."
dialogues.text:
"Being in love has its challenges, but to fall in love is
like magic itself."

dialogues.jp: ◆ばあちゃんの夢◆
dialogues.en: ◆Dreaming about grandma◆
dialogues.text: ◆Dreaming about grandma◆

dialogues.jp: その夜、ばあちゃんの夢を見た。
dialogues.en: I had a dream about grandma at night.
dialogues.text: I had a dream about grandma at night.

dialogues.jp:
魔法使いだったばあちゃんだが、彼女は恋をし
たことで魔法を捨てたのだという。
dialogues.en:
She was a witch, but she lost her magic because she fell in
love.
dialogues.text:
She was a witch, but she lost her magic because she fell in
love.

dialogues.jp:
「恋をするってことは、それだけ大変で――か
けがえのない魔法なんだから」
dialogues.en:
"Being in love has its challenges, but to fall in love is
like a magic itself."
dialogues.text:
"Being in love has its challenges, but to fall in love is
like a magic itself."

dialogues.jp:
そんな風に、心底嬉しそうにばあちゃんは笑っ
たのだった。
dialogues.en: She laughed happily as she said so.
dialogues.text: She laughed happily as she said so.
